tonight: Anniversary night on Santorini — caldera lights, just us.

postcard.title: Under the arches
postcard.note: Anniversary today. Wine tasting at Argyros yesterday — best pour of the trip so far.
postcard.caption: A kiss under a runway of white arches at Argyros. Soft landing at the best winery so far.

word.meaning: I love you. Anniversary on Santorini — said on the caldera.
